items.description:
Wild Side Creative is a Pretoria marketing agency built around seven core services: website design, build and ongoing maintenance with basic search engine optimisation; social media management to build brand presence and spark conversation; branding and logo design; graphic design for both digital and print use; and email marketing campaigns built to engage an existing audience.

The agency treats marketing as core to a business's goals rather than a purely visual exercise, pairing its designers with content marketers so visual work stays tied to a consistent brand message. Operating from Shere, Pretoria, Wild Side Creative also produces corporate presentations, making it suited to businesses wanting one agency to handle both the look of their brand and the channels used to promote it, from a logo redesign through to an ongoing social media or email programme.

Wonderboom Bird Park & Aquarium is an in-store pet shop in Annlin West stocking a wide selection of birds, aquatic life, cages and pet accessories at competitive prices. Staff are described as knowledgeable, offering care tips to both first-time pet owners and experienced hobbyists shopping for their collection.

The store supports in-store shopping with NFC mobile payments as well as credit and debit cards, and the premises have a wheelchair-accessible entrance and parking. With more than 900 customer reviews and an average rating above 4 out of 5, Wonderboom Bird Park & Aquarium is open daily from 8am to 5pm, serving pet owners in Annlin West and the wider Pretoria area looking for birds and aquatic pets alongside the cages and accessories to keep them.

ZF Lemförder South Africa's Rosslyn plant is a subsidiary of the global technology group ZF Friedrichshafen AG, and has supplied axle sets to BMW Group South Africa for the 3 Series since the plant's foundation in 1998, covering the E46, E90 and F30 generations. The facility marked production of its one millionth axle set with a family day attended by employees, global division executives and customer representatives.

ZF as a group works across transmission, steering and suspension technology for cars, commercial, agricultural and construction vehicles, and has been present in South Africa since 1969. The Rosslyn facility credits its track record to ongoing staff training, efficient workplace organisation and a close focus on customer requirements, positioning it as an established, long-running axle supplier within the Akasia and Rosslyn industrial area rather than a newer entrant to the market.

1 Circle Energy Group is a Centurion-based electrical and solar business with more than 20 years of experience, registered as an electrical contractor with the Department of Labour and a member of the Electrical Contractors Association of South Africa. Its solar division designs custom systems ranging from basic backup power to fully off-grid and automated setups for residential, commercial and industrial clients.

Beyond electrical and solar installation, the business also installs and maintains solar and conventional pool pumps, and offers a dedicated certificate-of-compliance service covering everything from initial assessments to ongoing monitoring and maintenance. Based in Wierdapark, Centurion, 1 Circle Energy Group suits homeowners and businesses needing an accredited contractor for electrical work, a solar installation, or COC compliance, rather than engaging separate specialists for each.

24/7 Centurion Plumbing covers emergency plumbing call-outs across Centurion, from burst pipes and blocked drains to geyser repairs and hidden leak detection behind tiles or under slabs. The team also handles smaller jobs such as dripping taps and running toilets, along with pipe installation for re-piping older homes or fitting out a new build, and diagnoses water pressure problems linked to valves or pressure-reducing valves.

The business assesses each job before quoting, so there is no call-out fee or surprise charge, and it charges per job rather than by the hour to avoid dragging a repair out. Operating around the clock from Heuweloord, Centurion, 24/7 Centurion Plumbing draws on local knowledge of common plumbing issues across Centurion's suburbs, and suits homeowners who need a plumber outside normal office hours as much as for planned bathroom renovation work.

Accommodation 4 SA is an online accommodation directory listing places to stay across South Africa and neighbouring countries including Botswana, Namibia, Lesotho, Mozambique and Swaziland, alongside listings in the United Kingdom. Its listings cover trending destination areas such as the Drakensberg, Garden Route, Dinokeng and the Kruger gateway, spanning hotels, lodges and self-catering options rather than a single accommodation type.

The platform also groups special-interest listings for shuttle services, pet-friendly stays, and accommodation suited to contractors, overnight travellers, business trips and safari or tour operators. Businesses can get listed directly on the platform. Operating from Heatherview, Pretoria North, Accommodation 4 SA is aimed at travellers planning a trip within the region who want to compare accommodation options by destination rather than searching property by property.

AccuLaser (Pty) Ltd is a Pretoria-based 3D design and perspex manufacturing studio, operating since 2018 from its workshop in Koedoespoort Industrial. The business laser-cuts retail display products, custom brochure holders, table talkers, pen racks and bespoke acrylic enclosures, using a CO2 laser cutter and heat-bending bench to produce consistent results from a single prototype through to high-volume production runs.

Alongside its perspex work, AccuLaser also offers laser engraving, MDF manufacturing and steel detailing, backed by 15 years of steel detailing experience within the team. It serves retailers, franchisors, stationers and corporate clients across South Africa. The studio is open Monday to Friday from 8am to 4pm, and suits businesses needing custom point-of-sale or display pieces made to a specific size or branding requirement rather than off-the-shelf fittings.

Ackermans is a South African value retailer selling affordable clothing, footwear and homeware, with a particular focus on women's, children's and school wear. This branch trades inside Kenny Shopping Centre in Bronkhorstspruit, one of the chain's stores carrying its usual seasonal catalogue specials alongside everyday ranges.

As with other Ackermans stores, shoppers can check current specials against the national catalogue, which runs across all branches rather than being unique to Bronkhorstspruit. The Kenny Shopping Centre branch is open Monday to Friday from 8am to 5pm, Saturdays from 8am to 1pm and Sundays from 9am to 1pm, giving Bronkhorstspruit shoppers a local Ackermans outlet for family clothing and school wear without needing to travel to a larger centre.

Acubenne (Pty) Ltd is a business consulting firm in Die Hoewes offering end-to-end support aimed at streamlining operations and improving cost efficiency, combining data-driven insights with strategic planning. Its core consulting work covers business development, strategy and operational improvement, marketing strategy and organisational restructuring, positioned as a way to bridge gaps in specialist knowledge without hiring in-house.

Beyond strategy work, the firm also offers practical outsourced support such as bookkeeping, invoicing and expense tracking, responsive customer service handling, and business intelligence, business analysis and AI services, alongside design, printing, and domain and website management. Based in Die Hoewes, Centurion, Acubenne suits small and growing businesses that want a single consulting partner covering both high-level strategy and day-to-day administrative support.

Acute Accountants is a cloud-based accounting firm with more than two decades of experience, serving more than 600 clients across Africa from its Rubenstein Drive office in Moreleta Park. Its services span all-inclusive monthly accounting, payroll and UIF administration, annual financial statements and reporting, individual tax services, and cloud-based accounting built specifically for real estate agencies.

The firm also negotiates directly with SARS on clients' behalf over outstanding tax debt, and runs cloud-based automation to simplify routine bookkeeping. It works across industries including real estate, restaurants, retail, collections agencies, e-commerce and start-ups, as well as with individuals. Open Monday to Friday from 8am to 4:30pm and closed over weekends, Acute Accountants suits businesses wanting a dedicated, tech-driven accountant rather than a once-a-year tax service.

items.description:
Afdakke Pretoria builds and installs carports (afdakke) that shield vehicles from sun, rain and hail, with the same covered space also useful for storing other equipment that would otherwise be left outside. The business has more than 20 years of experience in the steel industry and also installs residential and commercial steel gates, including swing gates and security gates, across the Pretoria area.

Its range extends to window and door security bars (diefwering) for residential and commercial properties, available in a variety of design styles for extra security, and it also builds boma and fire pit structures for patios, pool areas and gardens. Operating from Hermanstad, Pretoria, Afdakke Pretoria suits homeowners looking for a single steelwork contractor covering vehicle shelters, security gates, window and door protection and garden fire features.

Afrivet Warehouse is the Equestria base of Afrivet, established in 2000 to supply stock remedies and veterinary medicines developed for African farming conditions, backed by technical advice from a trained team and distributor network. Afrivet was acquired by Bimeda in August 2022, a global veterinary pharmaceutical manufacturer and distributor founded in Ireland in 1960 with six decades of experience in animal health.

Through the acquisition, Afrivet became part of Bimeda's AMEA division, headquartered in Kenya with further subsidiaries in Uganda, Tanzania and Zambia, giving Bimeda the largest footprint of any animal health company across Africa. Bimeda products are distributed in more than eighty countries from eleven manufacturing facilities across eight countries. Operating from Equestria, Pretoria, Afrivet Warehouse connects local farmers and animal owners to this wider international animal health network.

Al Faris Perfumes specialises in premium attar and perfume oils, including oud and amber musk blends such as its Bin Shaikh and Kalimat Oudh attars, alongside fresh aquatic Blue Oud options for customers wanting a lighter scent. The business also sells handcrafted bakhoor burners, including marble, German silver and geometric diamond-styled designs, aimed at creating a more considered home fragrance ritual rather than a simple scented candle.

Al Faris operates as an online store only, with no physical shop, though a local collection point is available in Laudium alongside nationwide delivery. That setup suits customers across South Africa who want niche attar and bakhoor products without a traditional perfume counter, ordering online and either collecting locally in Laudium or having their order delivered.

items.description:
Altis Biologics is a regenerative-medicine company based in Persequor, Pretoria, developing bone-graft products built around bone morphogenetic proteins to promote new bone formation. Its product line includes the Altis OBM range for trauma, maxillofacial and periodontal use, a stitchable fibrillar collagen membrane for guided bone regeneration in maxillofacial and neuro-surgery, and a ceramic graft substitute made by sintering porcine and cancellous bone.

The company has expanded steadily since commissioning dedicated bio-processing facilities at Bio Park in Pretoria's Innovation Hub Industrial Complex in 2019, scaling up production of its bone morphogenetic protein complex and humanised bone matrix the following year, and opening further research laboratories in 2021 focused on humanising xenogeneic bone into a bone graft substitute. Its more recent Alti Graft product is a novel load-bearing cancellous bone graft, also available in a larger Alti Bloc format.

amara is a family-centred, multi-cuisine restaurant and social space set within The Hills Game Reserve Estate in Garsfontein, overlooking a lake. Its name is inspired by the idea of grace: in how guests are welcomed, and in the way people naturally gather around a table to share food and conversation, with the space designed to invite both easy conversation and quieter, more focused moments.

The restaurant runs all day, from a quick breakfast or a midday work session through to a relaxed weekend brunch and a livelier evening atmosphere by the water as the sun sets. Open Monday to Friday from 10am to 9pm, Saturdays from 9am to 9pm, Sundays from 9am to 6pm and until 9pm on public holidays, amara suits families and groups looking for a multi-cuisine setting that works across breakfast, lunch and dinner rather than a single mealtime.

Amax Services is a Pretoria North accounting and advisory firm established in 1992, built around what it describes as one accountable relationship connecting a business to financial, compliance, legal, people, risk and technology specialists rather than a single accounting service. The firm organises its work into eleven specialist divisions, covering accounting, tax and reporting; CIPC governance and compliance; payroll, recruitment and HR support; and growth-related IT and insurance advice.

With more than 30 years of established experience, Amax positions its accounting work as the starting point from which other business decisions, such as tax, compliance and technology choices, are connected rather than handled separately. Based in Pretoria North, the firm suits small and medium businesses, trusts and non-profits wanting a single advisory relationship across several specialist areas instead of coordinating separate providers themselves.

Apex Business Solutions is a Lynnwood-based labour and HR solutions company offering recruitment support, including headhunting, screening and interviewing, alongside broader human resources work such as skills development, Employment Equity reporting and B-BBEE training. Client feedback describes the team as professional and well-trained in policy development, job descriptions and legal matters, taking on both short HR projects and more involved, longer-term assignments.

The business positions itself as a proactive partner rather than a purely reactive recruitment agency, aiming to document clients' HR processes and grow alongside their business as it expands. Based in Lynnwood, Pretoria, Apex Business Solutions suits businesses needing recruitment, compliance or skills-development support handled by a dedicated HR partner rather than managing these processes internally.

items.description:
AW Design is a graphic and web design studio in Pierre van Ryneveld, Centurion, with 32 years of experience in print design work such as logo design, packaging, catalogue design, signage and photography, alongside 20 years of web design experience. The studio works with Adobe Creative Suite to design e-commerce and WordPress websites, as well as PowerPoint presentations and printed business materials.

Its services also extend into content creation and management for social media platforms including Facebook, Instagram and X, giving clients a single point of contact for both their printed branding and their ongoing online presence. Operating from Pierre van Ryneveld Park, the studio is suited to small businesses and individuals needing a long-established, personally run design service rather than a large agency team.

BaseCloud supplies a combined sales and service platform for South African businesses, built around native VoIP calling, business texting, an official WhatsApp Business API integration, and email connected through Microsoft 365 or Gmail, all logged against a single client record. Every call is recorded, transcribed and summarised automatically, and incoming messages are matched to the right client rather than handled on a rep's personal phone.

Beyond communication, the platform covers sales pipelines with customisable stages, a quoting and pricebook system with bundled services and equipment, and shared support inboxes that route queries to the right person through an unclaimed queue. Automation and AI handle follow-ups and reporting without manual input. Operating from Shere, Pretoria, BaseCloud suits businesses wanting their calls, messages and quotes managed from one system rather than several disconnected tools.

Battery Corp Rooihuiskraal is one of five Battery Corp branches that have served Pretoria since 2004, combining the convenience of mobile battery fitment with a physical store customers can walk into for advice or after-sales support. The branch stocks car, bike and motorcycle, truck and commercial vehicle, and caravan, boat and jet ski batteries, covering AGM, SMF and EFB types.

Services include free battery testing, fast fitment while customers wait, emergency callouts to a customer's location, and recycling of old lead-acid batteries. Being part of an established, multi-branch local group rather than a mobile-only operator means the Rooihuiskraal branch can offer a real premises for warranty queries and advice alongside its fitment service, serving customers across the Rooihuiskraal area of Centurion who need a battery tested, fitted or replaced.

Battery Corp Wonderboom is one of five Battery Corp branches that have served Pretoria since 2004, combining the convenience of mobile battery fitment with a physical store customers in Annlin and Wonderboom can walk into for advice or after-sales support. The branch stocks car, bike and motorcycle, truck and commercial vehicle, and caravan, boat and jet ski batteries, covering AGM, SMF and EFB types.

Services include free battery testing, fast fitment while customers wait, emergency callouts to a customer's location, and recycling of old lead-acid batteries. Being part of an established, multi-branch local group rather than a mobile-only operator means the Wonderboom branch can offer a real premises for warranty queries and advice alongside its fitment service, serving customers in the Wonderboom and Annlin area who need a battery tested, fitted or replaced.

items.description:
BDJ Auditors Incorporated is a firm of registered chartered accountants and auditors formed in 1995, with the firm and its partners registered with both the South African Institute of Chartered Accountants and the Independent Regulatory Board for Auditors. Based in Garsfontein, the firm has grown substantially over the past decade, with small and medium-sized enterprises as its main target market.

That SME focus shapes how the practice works, favouring the kind of audit, tax and accounting support smaller businesses need rather than only large corporate audit mandates. Operating from Jacqueline Drive in Garsfontein, Pretoria, BDJ Auditors Incorporated suits small and medium businesses looking for a registered, dually accredited audit and accounting firm with a long-standing local presence rather than a newer or unregistered practice.

items.description:
Bevcan Factory Rosslyn is a beverage can manufacturing plant owned by Nampak, a company that describes itself as Africa's largest packaging business and has been listed on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange for 55 years. Nampak is repositioning itself as a focused metals packaging business, with manufacturing facilities in South Africa and Angola, and is the largest manufacturer of beverage cans in both countries.

In its home market, Nampak is also the only producer of two-piece tinplate cans and aluminium monobloc aerosol cans, giving the Rosslyn plant a role within a business that holds a distinctive position in metal packaging rather than competing as one of many similar can makers. Nampak also promotes the recyclability of its cans and continues working to reduce their weight, lowering the environmental impact of each can produced at plants such as Rosslyn.

Biomedical Emporium's head office in Die Wilgers is a cosmeceutical skincare company offering more than 40 professional skin care treatments targeting concerns such as ageing, pigmentation, acne, inflamed or sensitive skin, scarring and wounds. Its product ranges include the Helix Series of serums and treatments, along with dedicated Maternology and Bio-Baby ranges developed for pregnancy-related and infant skin needs.

Because its formulations are concentrated, the company recommends a patch test on a less hair-covered, more sensitive area of skin before full use, even though its products are described as hypoallergenic. Operating from Die Wilgers, Pretoria, and open Monday to Thursday from 8am to 5pm, Fridays from 8am to 3pm and Saturdays from 8am to 3:30pm, Biomedical Emporium suits customers seeking targeted, clinical-style skincare products for a specific skin concern rather than general cosmetic skincare ranges.

Black Lion Property Group is a Pretoria East property development company founded in 2015, built around overhauling the local property market with new technologies and development approaches rather than following the standard apartment model. Its completed work includes The Pearls, a luxury apartment and townhouse development on 20th Street in Menlo Park finished in April 2018, within walking distance of the Village development.

Later projects on its books include Brooklyn Point, Niuw Point and Black Lion Towers, continuing the same focus on apartments and penthouses in sought-after Pretoria East locations. The company also describes a commitment to its local communities, aiming to employ local companies and train individuals in specialised fields on each project. Based in Midfields Estate, Menlo Park, Black Lion Property Group suits buyers looking for newer, design-led apartment developments in Pretoria East.

Bliga Design Consultants is a Pretoria-based software development and web design consultancy offering website design and development, logo design, and domain and email hosting for clients in South Africa and abroad. Its packages range from small static websites through to larger content-managed sites, aimed at matching what a particular business actually needs rather than selling every client the same package.

The business also provides video and card invitation design, extending its design work beyond standard company websites and branding into more personal projects. It specifically caters to private individuals without large marketing budgets as well as larger businesses, offering competitively priced website design and development services. Based on the Gauteng border in Pretoria Central, Bliga Design Consultants suits clients wanting an affordable website or logo design option rather than a premium full-service agency.

Blossom Events and Decor is an event styling business in Monument Park offering floral design and thematic decorations to set the mood for weddings, corporate events and other celebrations. Its services also include décor and furniture hire, giving clients a range of items and styles to choose from without having to source pieces themselves.

Beyond styling and decor, the business runs full event planning and management, covering everything needed for a seamless event from initial planning through to the final set-down, and offers additional services such as promotional gifts, outsourced food and beverage coordination, event structures and audio-visual support. Operating from Monument Park, Pretoria, Blossom Events and Decor suits anyone planning a wedding, corporate function or milestone celebration who wants styling and logistics handled by one team.

Blue Label Technology Solutions is a Centurion-based cybersecurity services provider working across the full incident lifecycle: threat prevention before an attack, threat response during one, and threat investigation afterwards. Its security assessment service runs a thorough vulnerability assessment with actionable recommendations, while a separate compromise assessment looks for telltale signs that a system has already been breached.

The business also runs red team operations, simulating real-world attack scenarios so a client's security and IT teams can test and sharpen their response skills, alongside attack surface management and privilege and application management services. Citing research showing that most web resources carry at least one critical vulnerability and that a breach can cost data and money within an hour, Blue Label Technology Solutions, based in Eco-Park Estate, Centurion, suits organisations that need dedicated cybersecurity expertise rather than relying on general IT support.

Bohemian is a 12-room guesthouse in Waterkloof Ridge offering relaxed accommodation with what it describes as an extraordinary ambience, built around cosy beds, modern furnishings and plenty of natural light in each room. Guests have access to an outdoor pool and a courtyard garden with a fountain, winding paths and classical busts, giving the grounds what the guesthouse calls a touch of Europe.

A day spa on site offers massage treatments from a professional therapist, giving guests somewhere to unwind after a journey without leaving the property, and is open daily from 9am to 6pm. Located on Eridanus Street in Waterkloof Ridge, Pretoria, Bohemian suits travellers wanting a smaller, personally run guesthouse with its own spa and garden rather than a larger hotel.

Bokamoso Basechaba Professional Solutions is a 100% African-woman-owned professional services firm in Montana Park, started in 2014 around a flexible workforce model that combines permanent staff with free-agent industry specialists, allowing the business to respond quickly to urgent client needs. Its core departments cover international trade consultancy, business compliance, and import and export logistics, including customs clearing and freight forwarding.

The business also offers project management, procurement and distribution services, and runs its own School of Shipping, training clients and their staff in import and export procedures. Operating from Khai-Appel Street in Montana Park, Pretoria, Bokamoso Basechaba suits businesses that need support navigating international trade, customs and logistics, as well as those wanting in-house staff trained directly in shipping and import-export procedures.

items.description:
Boot and Rally is a leather and canvas goods retailer at Equestria Shopping Centre, selling handmade bags, wallets and belts made from genuine leather and cotton canvas. Its range runs from leather shoulder bags, sling bags and crossbody bags through to travel bags, duffles and toiletry bags, alongside named pieces such as the Ella, Lize-Marie, Anni, Megan and Jana bags.

Customers can also buy leather care cream to maintain their bags over time, and finished pieces are available for pickup directly from the brand's Factory Shop as well as from the Equestria store. Open Monday to Friday from 8am to 4pm and Saturdays from 8am to 1pm, Boot and Rally suits shoppers looking for handmade leather and canvas bags and accessories rather than a mass-produced, imported range.

Booysen Logistics and Services (Pty) Ltd is a transport and logistics company founded in 2018, with a workforce drawing on more than three decades of combined industry experience. Its core services cover ship's agency work such as marketing, space management, bookings and documentation, freight forwarding for import and export across all modes of transport, duty-paid warehousing, and transport logistics consulting including market sourcing and strategic sourcing advice.

The company holds B-BBEE Level 1 status with 135 percent procurement recognition, and positions itself around a hands-on, personal approach to clients of any size backed by 24/7 support. Operating from Jan Niemand Park, Pretoria, Booysen Logistics and Services suits importers and exporters needing freight forwarding, warehousing or shipping-agency support from a single logistics partner.

Briteidea is a Centurion-based supplier of educational resources for public schools, independent schools, home-schooling families and children with learning barriers. Its range covers mathematics materials for numbers and operations, space and shape, patterns and functions, data handling, measurement and time, alongside language resources for sequencing and storytelling, theme boxes, alphabet and vocabulary work, and phonics and word building.

The business also supplies life skills, science and technology, and inclusive education products, together with educational aids, classroom furniture, carpets and seating, charts and pocket charts, foam products and broader teachers' resources. Operating from Brooklands Lifestyle Estate, Centurion, Briteidea suits schools and parents looking for a single supplier covering both curriculum-specific teaching aids and the classroom furniture and seating that go with them.

Btax, trading under the Tax and Financial Reporting Specialist name, now operates as Charter Business Advisory, a firm of practising members of the Institute of Accounting and Commerce and the Chartered Institute for Business Accountants. The firm positions itself as more than number-crunching accountants, covering business registrations, workman's compensation and UIF alongside tax services spanning individual and corporate income tax, VAT, PAYE and customs.

Its accounting and reporting work includes financial statements, including for schools, and independent reviews, while its business advisory service covers business plans, budgeting, forecasting, accounting software and mergers. Charter Business Advisory also offers dedicated non-profit services such as exemption and Section 18A registrations, and employee services including payslips, UIF registration and employment contracts. Based in Booysens, Pretoria, the firm suits businesses needing combined tax, accounting and advisory support in one place.

items.description:
Building & Decor is a South African building-industry information source based in Erasmuskloof, Pretoria, publishing dedicated Walls & Roofs and Floors magazines alongside supplier directories and building-related articles. Its content is aimed at built-environment professionals, covering practical topics such as flooring finishes, waterproofing, insulation and thermal performance, and product features like LED aluminium lighting profiles.

The publication also runs DAS CPD events, giving architects, designers and other building professionals a way to earn continuing professional development credits alongside its magazines and catalogues. Operating from Erasmuskloof, Building & Decor suits professionals in the building and design trade looking for South African-specific product information, supplier directories and industry news rather than general consumer home-improvement content.

Bull Security concentrates its operations on the Eastern suburbs of Pretoria only, a deliberate choice that keeps its armed reaction and medical assistance units only a few minutes from any client in that area. Its central control station runs around the clock, with calls electronically logged and acted on under the supervision of senior watch commanders rather than left to a single operator.

The business's fleet of marked vehicles is staffed by officers registered with the Security Officers Board and trained to work above the industry's standard requirements, with vehicles placed strategically to minimise reaction times. Bull Security also offers a product called Bullseye AI as part of its security technology. Based in Clydesdale, Pretoria, Bull Security suits households and businesses in the Eastern suburbs specifically, rather than clients across the wider city, given its single-area focus.
